jobs.title: Behavioral Health Care Coordinator / Associate Therapist – Neurology
jobs.description:
VerityMD NeurologyLocations: Carmichael \& Folsom, CASchedule: Full\-Time, Monday–Friday

About the Position

VerityMD Neurology is seeking a Behavioral Health Care Coordinator / Associate Therapist to help develop our integrated behavioral health and neurobehavioral services.

This is a hands\-on clinical role working alongside neurologists, advanced practice providers, and a consulting psychiatrist. The position is ideal for someone interested in the intersection of behavioral health, neurology, chronic disease, and emerging treatments such as TMS and biofeedback.

Responsibilities

* Manage and follow a panel of behavioral\-health patients
* Support Behavioral Health Integration (BHI) and Collaborative Care Management (CoCM)
* Administer and review validated measures such as PHQ\-9, GAD\-7, and PTSD screening tools
* Conduct behavioral\-health assessments and follow\-up
* Develop and update care plans with the clinical team
* Monitor symptoms, treatment response, and functional outcomes
* Provide brief evidence\-based behavioral interventions within training and scope
* Participate in psychiatric case reviews when appropriate
* Coordinate care with neurologists, APPs, primary care, and behavioral\-health providers
* Maintain timely and accurate EHR documentation
* Support TMS patient screening, education, coordination, and outcome tracking
* Train in and support biofeedback/HRV biofeedback
* Help develop behavioral programs for patients with migraine, chronic pain, sleep disorders, dementia, Parkinson’s disease, and other neurological conditions
* Help develop efficient workflows and track clinical outcomes as the program grows

Qualifications

Preferred:

* Master’s degree in social work, counseling, psychology, marriage and family therapy, or related field
* California ASW, AMFT, or APCC registration
* Experience in behavioral health, counseling, integrated care, or care management
* Strong patient communication and engagement skills
* Excellent documentation and organizational skills

Experience with CBT, motivational interviewing, behavioral activation, CoCM/BHI, TMS, biofeedback, chronic pain, neurology, or Epic is a plus.

We are also open to an early\-career registered associate who is motivated to learn and grow with the program.

Schedule \& Locations

Monday–Tuesday: CarmichaelWednesday–Friday: Folsom

This is primarily an in\-person position supporting patients across both VerityMD locations.

Growth Opportunity

This is not a traditional administrative coordinator position. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to help build a growing neurobehavioral service line encompassing:

BHI/CoCM → behavioral interventions → CBT → biofeedback → TMS → integrated neurobehavioral care

Job Type: Full\-timeWork Location: Carmichael and Folsom, California

Pay: $27\.86 \- $33\.55 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Community Health Worker (CHW) — Certificate Pathway
jobs.description:
**Organization:** Hubbert Homes  
**Location:** Oakland and/or San Jose, CA  
**Schedule:** Full\-time or Part\-time  
**Work Format:** Field\-based / Hybrid, with option for telehealth check\-ins when appropriate

About Hubbert Homes

Hubbert Homes is a nonprofit transitional housing and sober living organization serving Alameda County and Santa Clara County. Its services include housing\-linked support for adults with complex medical, behavioral, and social needs, including Enhanced Care Management and other CalAIM\-aligned services coordinated with referral partners, hospitals, managed care plans, and community organizations.

Position Summary

The Community Health Worker supports clients through appointment coordination, referrals, service navigation, and ongoing follow\-up. This role helps clients access medical care, behavioral health care, recovery services, housing supports, benefits, and community resources, while strengthening continuity between Hubbert Homes and the larger care team.

This version is intended for candidates who already hold a **Community Health Worker certificate of completion** from a qualifying training program. DHCS states that for Medi\-Cal CHW services, CHWs may qualify through the certificate pathway, and the supervising provider is responsible for determining whether the certificate meets Medi\-Cal policy requirements.

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate appointments and referrals for medical, behavioral health, recovery, and social service needs
* Help clients navigate provider systems, complete next steps, and reduce missed appointments
* Provide outreach, engagement, reminder calls, and post\-appointment follow\-up
* Support intake, care planning, and coordination with internal staff and outside providers
* Document services, referrals, and client progress in a timely manner
* Maintain professional communication with referral partners, care teams, and Hubbert Homes leadership
* Assist with client education, resource navigation, and problem\-solving barriers to care
* Deliver a mix of field\-based, on\-site, phone, and telehealth support as appropriate

Minimum Qualifications

* High school diploma or GED
* **Current Community Health Worker certificate of completion** from a recognized or qualifying CHW training program
* Experience supporting clients with appointments, referrals, service coordination, navigation, outreach, or related work
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work independently while maintaining strong follow\-through and documentation
* Comfort working with clients experiencing complex social, medical, and behavioral health challenges

Desired, Not Required

* Experience with an **EHR system**
* Experience writing **case notes**, **intake assessments**, and **care plans**
* Experience in Medi\-Cal, ECM, Community Supports, or related care coordination settings
* Experience in housing, behavioral health, reentry, or recovery\-focused programs
* Bilingual ability
* Familiarity with Alameda County and Santa Clara County health and social service systems

Pay: $20\.00 \- $26\.00 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Oakland, CA 94606
